decisions.rationale: We are pivoting toward a science victory while keeping a credible military deterrent. Too many maxed flavors were diluting AI focus; by narrowing priorities to spaceship construction, science catch-up, and a tighter set of military needs, the empire can better challenge the Celts' lead without spreading production thin. We previously imposed an artificial -100 modifier against The Inca. Since The Inca are currently at war with The Celts—our main rival—this hostility serves no purpose and risks creating another front. Resetting our additive modifiers to neutral removes that artificial barrier, giving us diplomatic flexibility while we focus on The Celts.

Lowering MinorCivHostileBias reduces pointless antagonism toward neutral city-states. With the World Congress tight and city-state alliances mattering, we should not drive undecided city-states into The Celts' camp while we are occupied with the space race and total war.
